technical_requirements: Index scale target: start 100M vectors, plan to grow to ~1B vectors within 12 months.
Vector dim: 1,024 (unified model family), mixed metadata fields (jurisdiction, case_id, confidentiality flags).
Throughput: 500 qps sustained during business hours; peak spikes to 2k qps for e-discovery windowed runs.
Latency targets: retrieval p50 < 50ms, reranked top-3 end-to-end < 200ms; p95 under 500ms for heavy queries.
Cost target: <$0.002 per query (average, including reranking) or clear sizing tradeoffs to hit ARR goals.
High recall requirement for legal search — preference for ANN configurations tuned for recall > 0.95 at top-100.
Hybrid search: combine BM25 (Elastic) for exact match + embeddings for semantic recall; reranker uses cross-encoder on top-K.
Compliance: logs/audit trail for every retrieval, per-request metadata retention for 1 year, support for legal holds.
index_scale_targets: Phase 1: 100M vectors (6TB approx), Phase 2: 300-500M, Phase 3: ~1B; tiered storage desirable
reranking_strategy: Stage 1: ANN retrieval top-200 (vector+filter), Stage 2: lightweight lexical rerank (BM25 score fusion), Stage 3: cross-encoder re-rank top-10 with long-context model
Always keep provenance snippets and confidence scores in response for downstream workflows
connector_requirements: High-throughput upsert: 100k vectors/hour per tenant during initial ingest
CDC/streaming ingest support (Kafka connector preferred) for incremental document updates
Namespace/tenant isolation, RBAC enforcement at connector level
Metadata-aware filtering (compound filters, date ranges, jurisdiction tags)
Index management APIs: rebuild, partial-merge, compact, snapshot/restore
Observability: per-namespace QPS, latency, recall metrics, and cold-start metrics
Backpressure handling and bulk upsert batching controls
Support for quantized vectors (8-bit/4-bit) and ability to surface effective dimensions/recall tradeoffs
DR/replication: cross-region read replicas and fast failover for disaster recovery
cost_targets: Target blended cost/query (retrieval + rerank) <$0.002 for steady-state
Willing to accept higher cost for burst windows if predictable billing and caps available
Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations to reduce tokens/calls and leverage caching/prefix reuse
